subject.title: fix(gateway): keep channel lifecycle outside released request admission

question: Does the gateway owner accept moving all channel lifecycle promise creation outside request-scoped admission roots while retaining the existing process-global restart and suspension fences?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the ownership boundary of process-lifetime channel work in an availability-sensitive gateway path; this is a focused technical judgment, not a product-direction decision.

options.title: Refresh and accept the lifecycle boundary
options.body: Rebase or update to current main, re-run the focused and QA lifecycle proof on the final head, and merge if the global-fence behavior remains intact.

options.title: Keep lifecycle admission request-scoped
options.body: Reject the detachment approach and retain the existing behavior if gateway owners determine request-root inheritance is required for a currently undocumented lifecycle invariant.

recommendation.title: Refresh and accept the lifecycle boundary
recommendation.body: Rebase or update to current main, re-run the focused and QA lifecycle proof on the final head, and merge if the global-fence behavior remains intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author has the strongest available implementation context, while final acceptance should be made by the gateway-area reviewer who can confirm the intended admission invariant.
